name: Arnan
overview: Arnan was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Hananiah. His identity is briefly noted in Scripture without additional details or narrative context. There are no further recorded notes about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Arnan appears as a proper name in Scripture without any specified meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as is in 1 Chronicles 3:21.
familyAndRelationships: Arnan is explicitly identified as the son of Hananiah, indicating his place within a genealogical line in the tribe of Judah. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family connections for Arnan.
scriptureSignificance: Arnan's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical record of Judah, which preserves the lineage important for understanding the heritage of God's people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his mention upholds the biblical emphasis on family lines and God's providential preservation of His chosen tribe.
